title: Plan Share of a Counter Replacement: Computation Clause
content:
**Clause.** The plan's share of a replacement posted to a Road Hazard Protection certificate after a Crestline store carried it out at its counter is figured from the technician's reading of the replaced tire, as follows.

(a) *Service facts.* The service date, wheel position, store, odometer and measured tread of the posted replacement are those of the most recent Crestline tread inspection of the covered set recorded with the wear pattern damage, which is the technician's reading of the replaced tire.

(b) *Full-replacement period.* The replacement falls in the full-replacement period when, counting calendar months to the same day of the month, at least the plan term less the plan's full-replacement months remain as whole months from the service date to the expiration date, which is the same as the service date falling on or before the effective date plus the full-replacement months.

(c) *Counter-replacement coverage percentage.* It is 100 when the replacement falls in the full-replacement period and the tread worn (the tire line's original tread depth on its Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty line, less the measured tread) is at most the plan's full-replacement wear figure; otherwise it is the measured tread less the plan's coverage tread limit, times 100, divided by the line's original tread depth less the coverage tread limit, rounded down to a whole percent. Points added to or taken from the counter-replacement coverage percentage apply only to a prorated percentage, and a prorated percentage with every point that applies is held between 0 and 100; a counter-replacement coverage percentage of 100 under the full-replacement test stays 100.

(d) *Counter-replacement price.* The covered set's unit price on its original tire ticket.

(e) *Plan's share.* The counter-replacement coverage percentage times the counter-replacement price, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent, rounding only this final figure.

The plan figures named — term, full-replacement months, full-replacement wear and coverage tread limit — are those of the plan's term and replacement benefit schedules.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A 36-month plan with a 12-month full-replacement period, 2/32 wear allowance and 2/32 coverage limit; a line of 10/32 new tread; a damage reading of 7/32 taken with 20 whole months left to expiration. Twenty is below 36 less 12, so the period has passed; the percentage is 5 times 100 divided by 8, that is 62.5, rounded down to 62. On a hypothetical unit price of 129.99 the share is 62 times 129.99 divided by 100, 80.5938, rounded to 80.59.

With 26 whole months left and a reading of 9/32 (1/32 worn), the replacement is in the period and within the wear figure, so the percentage is 100 and the share is the full 129.99.
